_comment_: Slice 2.2: receipts come from a FOLDER of images/PDFs instead of a pre-extracted CSV. The tool OCRs each file (OpenAI vision for images, PDF text layer for digital receipts). Requires OPENAI_API_KEY. Run `expense-recon doctor --config run.with-folder.example.json` first to validate paths + env.

receipts._help: source 'folder' points at a directory of .jpg/.png/.webp/.pdf receipts. Omit `source` and the tool infers 'folder' from a directory path. default_currency fills in when a receipt does not state one.

llm._vision_model_help: OCR can use a stronger model than text categorization; defaults to `model` when omitted.
